item.title: Olympics: No update on whether Cassie Sharpe will ski in final after halfpipe crash
item.description: There was no word from Freestyle Canada or the COC on Friday as to the extent of Canadian Cassie Sharpe’s injuries or whether she would be able to compete in the halfpipe final on Saturday.

item.title: Bad Bunny positioned to consolidate his popularity in Brazil with first-ever performances
item.description: SAO PAULO (AP) — While Bad Bunny has dominated global charts, the superstar has not had quite the same success in Brazil , a country notoriously hard for foreign stars to win over due to a devotion to national artists.

item.title: Heli-skier dies in avalanche near Revelstoke, B.C.
item.description: REVELSTOKE — A heli-skier has died after being caught in an avalanche in southeastern British Columbia.

item.title: Riviera newcomers Penge and Bridgeman share lead at Genesis
item.description: LOS ANGELES (AP) — Marco Penge and Jacob Bridgeman had superb finishes at Riviera on Friday, each with a 7-under 64 that left them tied for the lead at the Genesis Invitational with Rory McIlroy right on their heels.

item.title: Canada reaches men's Olympic hockey gold-medal final in death-defying fashion
item.description: The Canadian men’s team rallied from a 2-0 deficit to edge Finland 3-2 to advance to the gold-medal final on Sunday.

item.title: Court clears way for Louisiana law requiring Ten Commandments in classrooms to take effect

item.title: When in Rome: Budapest pizzeria offers time-travel twist with ancient Rome-inspired pie
item.description: BUDAPEST, Hungary (AP) — In Hungary’s capital, a city best known for its goulash, a pizzeria is inviting diners to travel back two millennia to a time before tomatoes, mozzarella or even the word “pizza” were known in Europe.

item.title: In war-weary Kyiv, wounded Ukrainian veterans turn epic poetry into living testimony
item.description: KYIV, Ukraine (AP) — Sitting in a circle the day before opening night, Ukrainian war veterans and drama students took turns reading their lines from a script that traveled centuries to reach them.

item.title: Budget for new West Shore RCMP building to be reviewed
item.description: Langford, View Royal and Colwood are working with Advicas Professional Quantity Surveyors on a detailed review of the $103-million project.

item.title: Eby says B.C. could fight lumber tariffs in U.S. courts
item.description: B.C. Premier David Eby says that while a future legal challenge falls "pretty squarely" within federal responsibility, British Columbia might take a direct run at it.
